cases.sentence: ___ потеряли 60-ти тысячную русскую армию, и только, по словам Тьера, искусству и кажется тоже гениальности Мюрата удалось найти, как булавку, эту 60-ти тысячную русскую армию.
cases.explain: «Французские военачальники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: With reference to the military side—the plan of campaign—that work of genius of which Thiers remarks that, “His genius never devised anything more profound, more skillful, or more admirable,” and enters into a polemic with M. Fain to prove that this work of genius must be referred not to the fourth but to the fifteenth of October—that plan never was or could be executed, for it was quite out of touch with the facts of the case. The fortifying of the Krémlin, for which la Mosquée (as Napoleon termed the church of Basil the Beatified) was to have been razed to the ground, proved quite useless. The mining of the Krémlin only helped toward fulfilling Napoleon’s wish that it should be blown up when he left Moscow—as a child wants the floor on which he has hurt himself to be beaten. The pursuit of the Russian army, about which Napoleon was so concerned, produced an unheard-of result. The French generals lost touch with the Russian army of sixty thousand men, and according to Thiers it was only eventually found, like a lost pin, by the skill—and apparently the genius—of Murat.

cases.sentence: В отношении юридическом, после казни ___, сгорела другая половина Москвы.
cases.explain: «мнимых поджигателей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: With regard to legal matters, after the execution of the supposed incendiaries the rest of Moscow burned down.

cases.sentence: В ту же ночь пришли опять ломать двери и замки, рвать книги и производить ___.
cases.explain: «другие беспорядки» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: With regard to religion, as to which in Egypt matters had so easily been settled by Napoleon’s visit to a mosque, no results were achieved. Two or three priests who were found in Moscow did try to carry out Napoleon’s wish, but one of them was slapped in the face by a French soldier while conducting service, and a French official reported of another that: “The priest whom I found and invited to say Mass cleaned and locked up the church. That night the doors were again broken open, the padlocks smashed, the books mutilated, and other disorders perpetrated.”

cases.sentence: В ___, на провозглашение трудолюбивым ремесленникам и всем крестьянам не последовало никакого ответа.
cases.explain: «торговом отношении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: With reference to commerce, the proclamation to industrious workmen and to peasants evoked no response. There were no industrious workmen, and the peasants caught the commissaries who ventured too far out of town with the proclamation and killed them.

cases.sentence: ___ не было, а крестьяне ловили тех комиссаров, которые слишком далеко заезжали с этим провозглашением, и убивали их.
cases.explain: «Трудолюбивых ремесленников» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: With reference to commerce, the proclamation to industrious workmen and to peasants evoked no response. There were no industrious workmen, and the peasants caught the commissaries who ventured too far out of town with the proclamation and killed them.

cases.sentence: Не только ___, которые Наполеон так милостиво раздавал несчастным, не имели цены, но и серебро отдавалось ниже своей стоимости за золото.
cases.explain: «фальшивые ассигнации» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Even philanthropy did not have the desired effect. The genuine as well as the false paper money which flooded Moscow lost its value. The French, collecting booty, cared only for gold. Not only was the paper money valueless which Napoleon so graciously distributed to the unfortunate, but even silver lost its value in relation to gold.

cases.sentence: Но самое ___ недействительности высших распоряжений в то время, было старание Наполеона остановить грабежи и восстановить дисциплину.
cases.explain: «поразительное явление» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But the most amazing example of the ineffectiveness of the orders given by the authorities at that time was Napoleon’s attempt to stop the looting and reestablish discipline.

cases.sentence: Порядок еще не восстановлен, и нет ни одного купца, отправляющего торговлю ___.
cases.explain: «законным образом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Looting continues in the city despite the decrees against it. Order is not yet restored and not a single merchant is carrying on trade in a lawful manner. The sutlers alone venture to trade, and they sell stolen goods.”

cases.sentence: Существует шайка воров в нашем участке, которую надо будет остановить ___. 11-го октября.
cases.explain: «сильными мерами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Robbery and pillaging continue. There is a band of thieves in our district who ought to be arrested by a strong force—October 11.” “The Emperor is extremely displeased that despite the strict orders to stop pillage, parties of marauding Guards are continually seen returning to the Krémlin. Among the Old Guard disorder and pillage were renewed more violently than ever yesterday evening, last night, and today. The Emperor sees with regret that the picked soldiers appointed to guard his person, who should set an example of discipline, carry disobedience to such a point that they break into the cellars and stores containing army supplies. Others have disgraced themselves to the extent of disobeying sentinels and officers, and have abused and beaten them.”

cases.sentence: Войско это, как распущенное стадо, топча под ногами тот корм, который мог бы спасти его от голодной смерти, распадалось и гибло с каждым днем ___ в Москве.
cases.explain: «лишнего пребывания» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: That army, like a herd of cattle run wild and trampling underfoot the provender which might have saved it from starvation, disintegrated and perished with each additional day it remained in Moscow. But it did not go away.
